svg.text: GROOVEMORPH · concept sheet (static mock, illustrative data)
every thread = one slice of sound you are hearing, tied to the moment it was originally played
one ring per lap · wedge = placement window
laps 1–2 same · lap 3 evolved (+gate +half-time +tape-stop) · lap 4 = now
the real signal path, in order – what each stage is doing right now
bar under each stage = how much it is changing the sound now
2 of max 3 effects active · downbeat protect off · protect-lows 120 Hz
where you are, where you are going, and the way back
filled = sounding · ring = queued · bead = morph
